field_mappings.source_requirement: stable aggregate key pseudonymized with the reviewed tenant integration key
HRIS unit source ID pseudonymized with the org-unit namespace; must equal an HRIS records[].unit_id
calendar date of the aggregate in UTC, within [snapshot.period_start, snapshot.period_end)
map vendor to the schema enum; use other only when no reviewed enum value applies
map service to the coarse schema enum; never include product, prompt, or model text
nonnegative aggregate quantity and its schema-enumerated unit
nonnegative integer minor units, ISO 4217-style uppercase currency, and estimated or final status

minimum_required_data.structural: all envelope, snapshot, privacy, and record-required fields; zero records is allowed
minimum_required_data.usable_aggregate: one schema-valid record attributed to a known active HRIS unit and privacy.minimum_group_size >= 10
minimum_required_data.reconciliation: complete closed-period export with no sequence gap and final costs; partial or stale data is estimate-only

field_mappings.source_requirement: stable HRIS unit source ID pseudonymized with the org-unit namespace
parent HRIS unit pseudonymized identically, or null for a root; upserts only
map source hierarchy type to the coarse schema enum; do not export a source label
boolean source status; never infer from a missing partial record

minimum_required_data.structural: all envelope, snapshot, privacy, and operation-specific required fields; zero records is allowed
minimum_required_data.provider_attribution: a schema-valid active upsert whose unit_id equals provider records[].org_unit_id
minimum_required_data.topology: each parent is present in committed state or the complete export; partial unknown-parent records are quarantined

join_requirements.on_missing: quarantine the provider record; never assign a default unit
join_requirements.identifier_rule: exact opaque-ID match produced with the same tenant integration key, salt_scope, and org-unit namespace

partial.reason: completeness is partial, omitted_record_count is positive, or a declared issue reports missing or suppressed data
partial.behavior: accept independent valid records atomically; never infer deletion or synthesize omitted values; mark views degraded and provider totals estimate-only
partial.recovery: retry the same export or missing page, then request a complete snapshot or final closed-period export

stale.reason: sequence is below the committed high-water mark or freshness exceeds the contract target
stale.behavior: ignore sequence and revision rollback; retain last accepted state and warn; stale provider data cannot reconcile invoices
stale.recovery: verify producer clock and replay missing sequences or request a new complete export

duplicated.reason: export_id and content digest repeat, or identical entity and revision records repeat
duplicated.behavior: collapse identical copies to one no-op; conflicting content with the same identity is identity_conflict or revision_conflict
duplicated.recovery: acknowledge identical retries; for conflicts stop the source and issue a corrected higher revision with a new export_id

reordered.reason: a higher sequence arrives before a missing sequence, or record revisions arrive out of order
reordered.behavior: buffer sequence gaps and process numerically; greatest valid revision wins independent of array or arrival order
reordered.recovery: replay the gap and commit atomically in sequence order

malformed.reason: invalid JSON, duplicate keys, unsupported version, missing or unknown fields, bad formats, direct identifiers, content, or a group threshold below 10
malformed.behavior: reject the entire document to privacy quarantine; do not change state or the high-water mark
malformed.recovery: remove prohibited data, correct the mapping, validate against the exact schema, and issue a new export_id

valid.reason: the document matches the exact allowlisted schema and passes semantic, privacy, join, freshness, and ordering checks
valid.behavior: commit idempotently and retain only the allowlisted derived projection
